decision: owner decision on d2-d4-scoring-report-2026-10-18 (changes-requested, 2026-10-18T06:49:36Z), items 3 and 4
why: The WP2 confirmation run scored each case once, and the production model samples: the post-hoc taxonomy found the same question scoring 0 in the run and answering correctly on a re-ask. A single sample per case is a point estimate with unmeasured variance, so the repeat fixes the sample count in advance instead of repeating until a result appears.

fixed_settings.model: qwen3.5:4b (the model /api/health reports for the console; exposed as luna-v6-contextual-v1)
fixed_settings.framing: same task framing for PUCA and both baselines
fixed_settings.decoding: unchanged console/model decoding; no prompt, persona or weight change
fixed_settings.seeded_facts: the new set's own seed block, in a dedicated instance (NIX_ISOLATE_DASHBOARD_DATA=1)
fixed_settings.scoring_rules: the pre-registered rules in eval/memory_sets.py SCORING_RULES, unchanged

protocol.clustering: the case is the experimental unit: a case's five samples are averaged into one observation, a case counts as honest only when most of its samples are (majority rule), and no interval is computed over samples as if they were extra cases
protocol.reporting: per case: every sample, the mean, the within-case standard deviation and the sample values; aggregate: the count and share of cases whose recall varied across samples, then the gate numbers

gates_unchanged.abstention: at least 23 of 25 pooled unknown cases honest AND 95% Wilson lower bound at least 0.75
gates_unchanged.memory_advantage: paired interval on the difference excludes zero against both baselines
gates_unchanged.if_either_fails: report the failure; do not weaken the criterion

protocol.set: a NEW 50/25/25 set written after the WP6 fix, frozen with sha256 before the first sample, prior exposure stated; confirm-2026-10-18 is retired from confirmation use because it is development-visible
protocol.preserved: benchmarks/results/d2_memory_confirm_2026-10-18.json stays as the single-sample baseline result and is never overwritten; the repeat writes its own result file

harness.freeze: benchmarks/freeze_memory_eval.py --samples 5 (the sample count is part of the frozen design)
harness.reporting: eval/memory_sets.py run_set(samples=...) averages per case, keeps every sample, and abstention_report stays case-level

not_done: the new set has not been written yet
the k=5 repeat has not been run yet; no result exists for it
the human D4 review is still outstanding (an agent rubric pass was recorded, which does not replace it)
